recent.text: #NYR have doubled Chicago's shots through two periods (18-9) but still trail 2-1. The few Hawks' chances have felt more dangerous than anything the Rangers have generated at 5v5. Biggest issue remains general lack of offensive push.
recent.author: Vince Z. Mercogliano

recent.text: Multiple passes picked off on that #NYR power play and forced out of the zone. Heavy special teams game and Blueshirts are losing the battle right now.
recent.author: Mollie Walker

recent.text: This assist was #NYR J.T Miller’s 500th in the NHL. Nice one touch at the goal line. He has seven points in the last six games. His four game streak was halted in the team’s loss against BUF. Zibanejad and Miller both registered their 10th point of November on this play.
recent.author: Matthew Mugno

recent.text: This is the exact problem. Dylan Garand is playing his 20th career NHL game. Hes not Igor Shesterkin. You can’t just expect him to be stealing games, the amount of pressure that’s been put on this guy is beyond tough and he’s been pretty damn good for what #NYR have needed
recent.author: Jonny Lazarus
recent.quoted_text: @JLazzy23 Yeah, but I think it’s fair to argue that Garand really hasn’t stolen any games for us as of late. If anything he’s been the reason. You have to make more than 1 stop in one period of play
